# StretchablePhotonicInterconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A flexible optical waveguide architecture that maintains signal integrity while undergoing mechanical deformation, allowing dynamic reconfiguration of photonic network topology. Supports adaptive and reconfigurable TCC topologies where physical layout can change in response to computational demands, enhancing flexibility in in-network processing.
